references.text: The angel Gabriel gives a similar message to Abraham about Sarah, who was also childless but would give birth to a son.
This shows how God fulfills desires and prayers in accordance with his will, just as he did for Zechariah.
God remembers Rachel and opens her womb, which mirrors God's intervention for Elizabeth.
The birth and naming of John, fulfilling the angel's prophecy.
The angel instructs Joseph in a dream in a similar way, showing heaven's intervention in human lives.
